reviews.question: How many tasks did a person complete in a month?

issues: LIMIT 50 can truncate a month containing more than 50 deliveries; the answer must disclose truncation.

reviews.question: Summarize the my deliveries during a certain time period
reviews.retrieval_text: Summarize the my deliveries during a certain time period. Review a person's delivery output between start and end dates, including TLF volume and task counts. 汇总个人指定时间段的交付、TLF和任务量。 Person Delivery WORKS_ON.
issues: Returns only aggregate totals instead of the per-delivery CSR/SDA/STD/eSub breakdown required by skill.md.

reviews.retrieval_text: Summarize which studies I participated in delivering during a certain period. For each study, how many tasks were delivered? reviews.retrieval_text: Which domains have I worked on in the past period, how many times, and which ones were the most and least frequent? Rank SDTM experience frequency within dates and flag tied extremes. 统计一段时间内个人域经验次数及最多最少的域。 Person SDTM Delivery Actual_Delivery_Date.

reviews.retrieval_text: Please summarize the delivery efficiency of the past two weeks. Relate recent personal delivery task output to hands-on time and hours per task. 汇总个人最近两周交付效率及每任务工时。 Person Delivery TIME_ON WORKS_ON.

issues: Does not identify pending/unassigned TLFs or assess workload availability; repeats q130's historical lookup.
Uses legacy {tlfName} syntax and no LIMIT.

reviews.question: list domains a person has involved
reviews.retrieval_text: list domains a person has involved. Show SDTM and ADaM domains where an individual performed generation or QC. 列出个人实际参与编程或质控的数据域。 Person WORKS_ON HAS_SDTM HAS_ADAM Generation QC.
issues: Uses legacy {personName} syntax; duplicate query of q117/q118/q125.
Returns per-study rows with extra program/type fields; no TLF domains.

reviews.question: find which DIDs are available for filling in the daily survey
reviews.retrieval_text: find which DIDs are available for filling in the daily survey. Retrieve eligible personal time-reporting delivery identifiers by status and cutoff. 检索个人符合状态和日期条件的日报可选DID。 Person WORKS_ON Delivery DID_Status Actual_Delivery_Date.
issues: Duplicate q107, including missing comma in parameter JSON and legacy {parameter} syntax.
Actual-date cutoff removes active/planned deliveries with no actual date; no explicit survey eligibility field exists.

reviews.question: Compare TLF generation and QC across deliveries for Study C2321001
reviews.retrieval_text: Compare TLF generation and QC across deliveries for Study C2321001. Detect changes in TLF programming and QC owners between successive delivery versions. 比较研究C2321001各版本交付的TLF编程和质控人员变化。 HAS_TLF Generation QC Delivery Name.
issues: Assumes numeric delivery-name suffix defines chronological sequence.
Null-to-nonnull owner changes are lost through <> null comparisons; duplicate per-delivery TLF relationships can create spurious adjacency.

reviews.question: Compare SDTM generation and QC across deliveries for Study C2321001
reviews.retrieval_text: Compare SDTM generation and QC across deliveries for Study C2321001. Track SDTM domain generator and QC handoffs between delivery versions. 比较研究C2321001历次交付的SDTM编程和质控分工变化。 HAS_SDTM Generation QC Delivery Name.
issues: Assumes numeric suffix ordering rather than delivery dates.
Null owner transitions are not detected by <> comparisons; missing domains between versions are not reported.

reviews.question: Compare ADaM generation and QC across deliveries for Study C2321001
reviews.retrieval_text: Compare ADaM generation and QC across deliveries for Study C2321001. Compare analysis dataset ownership across consecutive study deliveries. 比较研究C2321001不同交付版本ADaM编程与QC人员变动。 HAS_ADAM ADaM Generation QC.
issues: Numeric delivery-name suffix ordering is an undocumented chronology assumption.
Null owner transitions are not detected by <> comparisons; only shared named domains with changed owners are returned.

reviews.question: Top 10 studies with high TLF volume
reviews.retrieval_text: Top 10 studies with high TLF volume. Rank study output volume and include SDSL, group/TA leads and study milestones. 查看TLF总量最高十项研究及负责人和研究信息。 Study Delivery CSR_TLF_Num Study_Info TA REPORTS_TO.
issues: Grouping by d.SDSL can split a study's volume; multiple hierarchy matches can multiply summed volumes.
Group_Lead/TA_Lead nonempty checks can accept N rather than Y.

reviews.question: Top 10 studies with high TLF volume in last 3 months
reviews.retrieval_text: Top 10 studies with high TLF volume in last 3 months. Rank completed study TLF output across the previous three full calendar months with leadership information. 查看最近三个完整自然月完成TLF量最高十项研究。 Study Delivery Completed Year Month CSR_TLF_Num.
issues: Grouping by delivery SDSL can split study totals; multiple leadership ancestors can multiply volume.
Uses previous full months rather than rolling three months.

reviews.question: Top 10 studies with high TLF volume in a target quarter
reviews.retrieval_text: Top 10 studies with high TLF volume in a target quarter. Rank study completed output volume for a chosen year and quarter. 查询指定年份季度TLF量最高十项研究及负责人。 Study Delivery CSR_TLF_Num Year Month Study_Info.
issues: Quarter/year are hardcoded to 2025 Q1 instead of parameterized.
Grouping by SDSL and multiple hierarchy matches can split/inflate volume.

reviews.question: Completed delivery task and hands-on hour summary
reviews.retrieval_text: Completed delivery task and hands-on hour summary. Pair completed delivery task output with total DIDN monthly effort. 汇总已完成交付任务量与实际投入工时。 Delivery DIDN_Month Hour CSR SDA STD eSub.
issues: Mandatory DIDN_Month excludes completed deliveries with no logged month.
Returns combined Task only rather than required CSR/SDA/STD/eSub split; SUM(dm.Hour) assumes numeric storage.

reviews.question: Person task and time spent on completed deliveries
reviews.retrieval_text: Person task and time spent on completed deliveries. Show personal effort per finished DID and hours per task. 查看个人每个已完成交付的任务、工时及单位任务耗时。 Person WORKS_ON TIME_ON DIDN_Month Delivery Completed.
issues: SUM(WORKS_ON counts) repeats task volume for multiple time records.
SUM(DISTINCT t.Hour) incorrectly collapses separate records with equal hour values.
Missing required CSR/SDA/STD/eSub split and Deliverable_Detail.

reviews.question: Ongoing/planned deliveries for a specific person in next 6 months
reviews.retrieval_text: Ongoing/planned deliveries for a specific person in next 6 months. List personal active delivery commitments and task volume over the next half year. 列出个人未来半年进行中及计划交付和任务量。 Person WORKS_ON Delivery Ongoing Planned Year Month.
issues: Inclusive currentMonth through currentMonth+6 spans seven calendar months.
Task_Num is combined rather than required CSR/SDA/STD/eSub fields; Deliverable_Detail omitted.

reviews.question: Studies where SDSL is from India site
reviews.retrieval_text: Studies where SDSL is from India site. Find studies whose designated SDSL belongs to the India office, with study milestones. 查询SDSL来自印度站点的研究及基本信息。 Study SDSL Person FROM_SITE Site India Study_Info.

reviews.question: Active Phase III studies and SDSL information
reviews.retrieval_text: Active Phase III studies and SDSL information. List active third-phase studies with SDSL and reporting leadership. 查询活跃三期研究及SDSL、组负责人和TA负责人。 Study_Info Plan_Phase Plan_Status ACTIVE Study Person.
issues: Assumes PH III spelling for non-controlled Plan_Phase; leadership nonempty flags can accept N and multiple ancestors may duplicate rows.

reviews.question: LoT for a specific DID
reviews.retrieval_text: LoT for a specific DID. Display SDTM ADaM TLF inventory and generation/QC assignments with filenames and output numbers. 查看指定DID的LoT清单、编程质控人员及文件编号。 Delivery HAS_SDTM HAS_ADAM HAS_TLF File_Name TLF_Number.
issues: Uses undocumented TLF.Type rather than TLF_Type.
OPTIONAL MATCH products can be large and collected all-null item maps can create phantom blank rows.

reviews.question: Person tasks for a specific delivery
reviews.retrieval_text: Person tasks for a specific delivery. Retrieve one person's assigned SDTM ADaM TLF items and output responsibilities within a DID. 查看某人在指定交付中负责的域、TLF及编程QC任务。 Person WORKS_ON Delivery HAS_SDTM HAS_ADAM HAS_TLF.
issues: Uses undocumented TLF.Type rather than TLF_Type.
Personal combined Task_Num is repeated per output row and lacks required CSR/SDA/STD/eSub split; optional null-item maps may yield blank rows.

reviews.question: Team members reporting to recursively identified manager
reviews.retrieval_text: Team members reporting to recursively identified manager. Resolve a person's management chain then list the selected manager's direct reports. 沿个人汇报链查找经理及其直属团队成员。 Person Manager REPORTS_TO.
issues: Nonempty Manager does not ensure Y; multiple matching manager ancestors create multiple teams rather than selecting nearest manager.

reviews.question: Members working on a study's ongoing/planned deliveries and other active workload
reviews.retrieval_text: Members working on a study's ongoing/planned deliveries and other active workload. Compare a study team's target-study assignments with their other active delivery commitments. 查看某研究活跃交付人员同时承担的其他研究任务。 Study Person WORKS_ON Delivery DID_Status.
issues: Negative status filter includes Overdue and undocumented TERMINATED rather than explicit Ongoing/Planned.
Returns nested aggregate task maps rather than required individual-delivery CSR/SDA/STD/eSub and detail fields.

reviews.question: Task and hour contributions by TA Lead for one delivery
reviews.retrieval_text: Task and hour contributions by TA Lead for one delivery. Compare TA-lead teams' task contributions, hours and effort per task for a selected DID. 按TA负责人汇总某个交付的任务贡献、工时及效率。 Person TA_Lead REPORTS_TO WORKS_ON TIME_ON Delivery.
issues: Independent CALL subqueries form a cross-product of task TA leads and hour TA leads without joining names, attributing hours to wrong leads.
Nonempty TA_Lead can include N; output lacks per-delivery task split.

reviews.question: Task and hour contributions by Site and Year for completed deliveries
reviews.retrieval_text: Task and hour contributions by Site and Year for completed deliveries. Aggregate completed task output and logged hours by office and year. 按站点和年份统计完成交付的任务、工时与单位耗时。 Person FROM_SITE Site WORKS_ON TIME_ON DIDN_Month.
issues: Tasks grouped by delivery.Year but hours by DIDN_Month.Year, so ratio can compare different activity periods.
Aggregate reporting omits required per-delivery task rows.

reviews.question: Task and hour contributions by TA Lead for completed deliveries
reviews.retrieval_text: Task and hour contributions by TA Lead for completed deliveries. Summarize completed delivery task volume and effort for each TA-lead reporting tree. 按TA负责人汇总其团队已完成交付的任务和工时。 Person TA_Lead REPORTS_TO WORKS_ON TIME_ON Delivery.
issues: Nonempty TA_Lead check can include N and multiple reporting paths can duplicate contributions.
Tasks and hours exclude TA lead's own effort because traversal is 1..; per-delivery task rows absent.

reviews.question: Task and hour contributions by Group Lead under a TA Lead for completed deliveries
reviews.retrieval_text: Task and hour contributions by Group Lead under a TA Lead for completed deliveries. Break a TA lead's completed delivery output and effort down by group leadership. 在指定TA负责人下按组负责人汇总已完成任务与工时。 Person Group_Lead TA_Lead REPORTS_TO WORKS_ON TIME_ON.
issues: Group_Lead nonempty check can include N; group ancestor is not required to lie below the specified TA lead.
Multiple hierarchy paths can duplicate task/hour contributions; lead self-contributions and required per-delivery rows omitted.

reviews.question: Please list the studies that contribute to Litfulo vitiligo submission and show study DSP category.
reviews.retrieval_text: Find studies supporting a submission by project or submission name keywords, with DSP category. 查询递交关联研究及DSP分类。 Study HAS_DELIVERY Delivery HAS_DID0 DID0 SUPPORT_SUBMISSION Submission Project_Name HAS_DETAIL Study_Info DSP_Flag.
issues: Independent optional Delivery and DID0 matches can multiply intermediate rows before DISTINCT; LIMIT 50 can truncate results.

reviews.question: Who in China contributed to Litfulo vitiligo submission
reviews.retrieval_text: Who in China contributed to Litfulo vitiligo submission. Find China delivery contributors, study SDSL and China PoC for a submission. 查询中国参与递交的人员、研究负责人和中国联络人。 Person WORKS_ON Delivery SUPPORT_SUBMISSION Submission FROM_SITE Site Study SDSL SDSA_China_PoC HAS_DID0 DID0.
issues: UNION removes exact duplicate rows, not duplicate people across roles or evidence lists; do not count rows as unique contributors.
China PoC may be a study name string without a matching Person or site; LIMIT 50 can truncate role/evidence rows.

reviews.question: Which teams across China supported Litfulo vitiligo submission
reviews.retrieval_text: Which teams across China supported Litfulo vitiligo submission. Return distinct team lead names of China contributors supporting a submission. 查询中国支持递交的团队及团队负责人，不列出所有个人。 Person Team_Lead_Name WORKS_ON Delivery SUPPORT_SUBMISSION Submission FROM_SITE Site SDSL.
issues: Only delivery contributors and SDSL reached through Delivery are included; DID0-only studies and China PoC-only contributors are omitted.
A team is the contributor's current Team_Lead_Name, not necessarily their team when the submission work occurred; LIMIT 50 can truncate teams.

reviews.question: How many datasets and TLFs have been delivered for B798h – Submit NDA (R1, 50 & 100mg, IA) submission
reviews.retrieval_text: How many datasets and TLFs have been delivered for B798h NDA submission. List delivered SDTM ADaM dataset and TLF counts per delivery using actual delivery dates. 查询递交已交付数据集及TLF数量，按交付逐行返回。 Submission Name Study HAS_DELIVERY Delivery SUPPORT_SUBMISSION Actual_Delivery_Date CSR_SDTM_Num_Total CSR_ADaM_Num_Total CSR_TLF_Num_Total.
issues: Match the compound code and submission type on Submission.Name only; ignore parenthetical dose and round words.
Returns per-delivery rows rather than a single total; LIMIT 200 can truncate rows, so do not report their sum as an unqualified global total.
